_comment: Which runtime payloads a release ships, since when, and what other hosts do (v0.38.0 A1). Consumers: release-completeness.yml, sync_windows_release.py, verify_docs_sync (platform table), the installer's SUPPORTED/FALLBACK constants (lockstep test). v0.38.1 R16: `min_os` per platform is copied into the release manifest by generate_release_manifest.py so install can refuse an old host BEFORE the 730 MB download.

darwin-arm64.label: macOS (Apple Silicon)
darwin-arm64.min_os_note: macOS 11 Big Sur is the first macOS on Apple Silicon; the embedded Node 22 / Temurin 17 need 11+ too

win32-x64.label: Windows (x64)
win32-x64.min_os_note: Windows 10 1809 / Server 2019: the oldest host the embedded x64 JDK 17 + Node 22 + CPython 3.12 support

core_js._comment: v0.50.0-dev E-02: the platform-independent JS engine (pure JS + production node_modules). Built by scripts/build_core_js_asset.py, uploaded to the draft by publish_release.sh, listed in the release manifest under the top-level `core_js` key (never under `platforms`: old installers and --expect-platforms read that set) by generate_release_manifest.py --core-js-archive. The installer fetches it wherever no runtime archive supplies the engine (Linux, Intel Mac, `install --engine-only`). Consumers: verify_runtime_release.py, sync_windows_release.py --check, verify_published_release.py (release-completeness.yml), the installer's ENGINE_ASSET_* constants (lockstep test).
core_js.label: JS engine only (any OS; needs Node >= 20.10 on PATH)

win32-arm64.evidence: A0 runner-probe on windows-11-arm: x64 Temurin 17, x64 Node 22 and x64 embedded Python 3.12 all run under Windows 11 emulation

unsupported.darwin-x64: Intel Mac: the arm64 payload cannot run under Rosetta (embedded JDK/Python are native arm64); deliberately not built this round (user decision 2026-09-10) — gateway mode via HOROSA_SERVER_ROOT / HOROSA_CHART_SERVER_ROOT
unsupported.linux-x64: experimental builder only, no published payload — gateway mode
